name: lts
description: Use LTS — a git worktree manager for multi-repo workspaces — from Claude Code: skills to start, sync, finish and tidy worktrees, plus SessionStart/SubagentStart hooks that tell every session (and subagent) which worktree it is in. Requires the lts CLI v3.2+ on PATH (curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/led-slzr/lts/main/install.sh | bash).
